name: Maverick Winery
notes: Winery, inventory, brand and licences to 1605274 B.C. Ltd.; agreement dated September 29, 2026, approval order October 23. Closing not confirmed. Excludes the 77-acre Crux Vineyard. No formal asking price in the court process; $4.65M is the earlier advertised price.

name: Terralux Estate Winery
notes: Sold June 3, 2026, per an article written by the listing agents. Partly built winery, sold as is. First marketed at $8.56M; $4.5M was the court listing. BC Assessment was $2,075,028 at July 1, 2025.

name: S'milka Vista Winery
notes: Listing is tagged SOLD at its $4.95M asking price, and its text gives a $3.2M accepted offer with competing bids allowed in court on June 17. Final price not confirmed and may be higher. Reported to exclude the winery business.

name: Foxtrot Winery
notes: Property and all business assets, sold December 18, 2024, to Silhouette Cellars; the article was written by the buyer's agents. Debts listed were more than $11M. Receiver was PwC. Asking price not stated.

name: Liquidity Wines
notes: Bought by Anthony von Mandl's company in March 2020, per Business in Vancouver and The Drinks Business. Articles could not be opened. Acres not confirmed.

name: 20818 McDougald Road winery
notes: Closed February 26, 2020. Commercial winery, event space, lake frontage and a five-bedroom house. The article doesn't say whether the brand or inventory were included.

name: Hainle Estate Winery
notes: Sold to Bella Valley Enterprises for $3.9M, per reporting on a 2025 court decision. More than $2M of inventory was covered by a separate unwritten agreement, so the total may be higher. The property was listed at $3.88M in 2026 as property only, in a foreclosure sale.

name: Black Hills, Gray Monk and Tinhorn Creek
notes: Andrew Peller deal for three established wineries, so not comparable to a single small winery. Tinhorn Creek was still at letter of intent when reported. Search results report $31M for Black Hills alone.
